daily.today_energy: The Moon in Pisces is softening your emotional landscape, while the Sun-Mars square might create some internal friction. You're feeling introspective but restless—lean into your Cancer instinct to process things slowly rather than react quickly.
daily.love: Venus sextile Jupiter is working in your favor, bringing warmth to your connections. If you've been holding back, today's energy supports vulnerability. Your people are ready to meet you halfway, so let them in a little more.
daily.career: Mars conjunct Jupiter is amplifying ambition across the board, but the Sun square Mars wants you to slow down and check your motives first. Channel this fire into strategic moves rather than rushing. Quality over speed wins today.
daily.health: Your nervous system might feel a bit activated with these fire placements. Ground yourself through water—literally or metaphorically. A walk, a bath, or just sitting with your feelings will help more than pushing through.

weekly.overview: This week feels like a reset button for your whole vibe. Mercury's moving through your sector of reflection, so expect some clarity about what you actually want versus what you think you should want. Trust the downloads.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is prime time for real conversations that go deeper than surface level. Single? Your energy is magnetic right now, but don't force it. Let people come to you. Quality over quantity always.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are firing on all cylinders. Whether it's a project or how you present yourself, lean into what feels authentically *you*. Your unique perspective is literally your superpower this week.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for more rest and less rushing. Listen to what feels nourishing—whether that's movement, food, or just sitting still. This is about tuning into your rhythm, not fighting it.
